description: This protocol performs a full custom PCR prep and post-PCR magnetic bead cleanup protocol for up to 96 samples. If both steps are run, the user will be prompted to run PCR off of the robot deck, and to replace the reaction plate onto the magnetic module for cleanup.
tags: PCR Prep and Magnetic Bead Cleanup
